issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the Farm feeding operation: the template's example usage in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java calls farm.feed(), while the problem statement (Part 3) and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch of the public API name (feed vs. feedAllAnimals) can confuse students about which method to implement or call and may lead to compilation or behavioral mismatches between their implementation and the provided example.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent between the example usage and the specified API. Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (template) to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), so the sample code matches the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively (less preferred), if a shorter name is desired, rename the Farm method feedAllAnimals() to feed() consistently across the project and update the problem statement accordingly.
